title: Azusawa Kohane — To Be Worthy〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: Young Vivid Street Locals
rows.Line: Uhh... We'll keep rooting for you and your team moving forward, Azusawa!

rows.Speaker: Young Vivid Street Locals
rows.Line: And thank you so much for letting us shake hands with you. We really appreciate it...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Thank you as well!
Anyway... Let's all keep doing our best.

rows.Speaker: Young Vivid Street Locals
rows.Line: Let's...!
se_walk_women_004_1

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (It really is nice to have people show their support for us like this.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Nice work, Azusawa.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You seem to have gotten a little more used to talking to your fans.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Y-You think so...?
I still feel pretty nervous when it happens, and I never really know what to say...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But I guess I have gotten more used to doing this compared to before.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Oh, that's right.
You seemed so overwhelmed in the beginning.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Or rather, you kept freezing up.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: H-Haha... I did...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I was so startled the very first time when that girl came up to talk to me.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (That time...)

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Here's your usual cafe au lait.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank you, I really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
I'm not seeing any of the others...
Are you by yourself today, Azusawa?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: The others said that homeroom is taking a little longer than expected. But they should be here soon...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Okay. In the meantime, make yourself at home!
se_walk_women_004_2

rows.Speaker: Young Vivid Street Local
rows.Line: U-Umm... Pardon me!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Young Vivid Street Local
rows.Line: Umm... So...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Oh, sorry about that. Are you waiting to order? I'll be over in just a second.

rows.Speaker: Young Vivid Street Local
rows.Line: Oh, no... It's just...

rows.Speaker: Young Vivid Street Local
rows.Line: Apologies if I'm mistaken, but are you Azusawa from Vivid BAD SQUAD...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh? Y-Yes, that's me...

rows.Speaker: Young Vivid Street Local
rows.Line: I knew it...! U-Umm...!

rows.Speaker: Young Vivid Street Local
rows.Line: I'm actually a huge fan of yours...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Umm... I...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(Wh-What do I do...?!
Sh-She's my fan? And she wants to talk to me...?)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (What am I supposed to do in this—)

rows.Speaker: Young Vivid Street Local
rows.Line: I... I haven't been able to get your performance out of my head after seeing you at RAD BLAST! And...!

rows.Speaker: Young Vivid Street Local
rows.Line: And... Uhh... Wh-What was I going to say...?!

rows.Speaker: Young Vivid Street Local
rows.Line: There was so much that I was going to tell you, but I've forgotten most of it...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: U-Uhh... That's okay!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You... You made it clear how inspired you feel...!

rows.Speaker: Young Vivid Street Local
rows.Line:
*Sob*
I wish I could tell you more eloquently...

rows.Speaker: Young Vivid Street Local
rows.Line: But I promise to keep supporting you and your team...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Thank you...!
I really appreciate it!
se_walk_women_004_3

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Geez...
Talk about tense.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That time, I really wasn't expecting anyone to come up to me and tell me that they're a fan of mine.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Yeah, I got that.
I mean, you two really didn't know what to say to each other.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Compared to then, you've improved a lot.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I stand to learn quite a bit from your example.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
N-No, you're giving me too much credit...!
I really wish I could interact with people the way An and Shinonome do since I still get nervous each time this happens.

rows.Speaker: Young Vivid Street Local
rows.Line: I... I haven't been able to get your performance out of my head after seeing you at RAD BLAST! And...!

rows.Speaker: Young Vivid Street Locals
rows.Line:
We're still really terrible...
But we're going to do our best as a team in order to become amazing singers like you guys...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I really couldn't be happier that people are coming up to us to show their support...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Which means I need to keep doing my best in order to not disappoint them!)
